title: Healthy Habits
text:
Healthy habits make us strong. We should eat fruit and vegetables every day. We should drink water when we are thirsty. We should sleep well at night.

Exercise is also important. Ali walks to school every morning. On Saturday, he plays football with his friends. He feels happy and full of energy.

questions.text: What should we eat every day?
How does Ali go to school?
Why does Ali probably feel happy and full of energy?
options: He does exercise and plays sports

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Healthy habits are good for us

vocabulary.definition: plants that we eat as food, such as carrots or tomatoes

paragraph_translations: Sağlıklı alışkanlıklar bizi güçlü yapar. Her gün meyve ve sebze yemeliyiz. Susadığımızda su içmeliyiz. Geceleri iyi uyumalıyız.
Egzersiz de önemlidir. Ali her sabah okula yürür. Cumartesi günü arkadaşlarıyla futbol oynar. Kendini mutlu ve enerji dolu hisseder.
